text: Implemented rigid pose plus scalar PE displacement T(x)=A[x+e d(x)]+t in observed moving-world millimetres. Acquisition metadata resolves exactly one voxel axis/polarity through the full index-to-world linear affine and fails on missing/ambiguous/invalid inputs. The compiled field retains only the fixed source-geometry weighted-mean gauge from PhysicalSpectralBasis3, reports nominal/effective ranks, preserves linear-like PE variation under rigid pose, defaults to a 32-256 coefficient policy with 64 recommended, and applies strictly positive magnitude plus gradient/bending precision. Streaming map/JVP/VJP kernels share one rotated PE vector and one gradient-dot-(A e) scalar per intensity sample; pose and field derivatives, prior value/gradient/curvature, workspace ownership, and exact proposal increments are typed. JVM and Scala.js PeFieldModelSuite: 5/5 each. Tests cover oblique/sheared/reflected PE direction, missing/ambiguous metadata, map finite differences, JVP/VJP adjoint identity, all intensity columns, prior finite differences and positive mode precision, and the 32-mode default coarse basis without inappropriate affine gauge removal. The supplied seeded Python oracle also passed, including PE determinant identity 0.0 absolute error, PE spatial Jacobian 2.0727124937653196e-09 relative error, and Schur identity 2.4441058062839556e-16. These are algebra checks, not MRI accuracy or timing. git diff --check passed.
